body:
---
Touches: argocd/resources/openrouter-proxy/router.py, agents/agent-session.sh
Class: fix

---
## Symptom (board-sweep 2026-10-14)

`RouterRunModelUnverifiable{stack=platform, role=worker, requested=opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash}` has fired since at least 2026-10-13 22:23Z, when Prometheus restarted. The cause is two `run_reports` rows in the proxy's store:

| ts | session | task | outcome | cost_usd | served_model |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-11 17:42Z | agent-homelab-173847 | adhoc-20261011T173846Z | clean | 0.0 | '' |
| 2026-10-11 18:06Z | agent-homelab-180559 | adhoc-20261011T180558Z | clean | 0.0 | '' |

These are the seat's sleep-tracking#67 probe rides. An ad-hoc `--run` needs `--model` to pass the chainless guard, but it never calls an LLM, so there is no served side to find. `model_drift_rows()` counts every `run_reports` row with `outcome != 'failed'` over 7 days, which latches the alert for about 7 days. It clears around 2026-10-18 18:06Z. The seat's 10-11 18:45Z pickup recorded this as "a launcher no-LLM probe flag is unbuilt, not filed"; this issue files it.

## Prior art

#748 excluded known-failed rides from the same query, and #752 and #575 fixed other unverifiable-row classes. All are closed. This is the next sibling: a ride that, by construction, made no model call.

## Fix shape (the worker's call)

One option: the launcher gets a no-LLM probe flag that writes a distinguishable `run_reports` row (an outcome or rail value), and `model_drift_rows()` excludes it. Add a decision-table row in the router tests for each excluded class. Do not exclude rows on `cost_usd == 0` alone, because a harvest miss looks the same.
title: model_drift_rows(): a no-LLM probe ride reads as unverifiable and latches RouterRunModelUnverifiable for 7 days
